name: discord-mcp
description: Discord MCP for Cursor. Send/reply/edit messages, manage channels/roles/webhooks/commands, read guilds. Supports DMs.

DISCORD_TOKEN.title: Discord Bot Token
DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Bot token from Discord Developer Portal (Bot tab). Required for MCP server.

DISCORD_DM_TOKEN.title: Discord DM Token (optional)
DISCORD_DM_TOKEN.description: Optional separate token for DM tools. Falls back to DISCORD_TOKEN if unset.
